failure_units.denominator: structure replacement cost new of the same reference building (the sources state loss as building value)
failure_units.source_atom_note: Failure unit = the roof structure; its loss states are expressed as a share of the whole building.

included: uniform (balanced) snow on the roof exceeding roof serviceability, partial-failure or collapse capacity
excluded: drifted and unbalanced snow (about 75 % of past failures by one insurance account; not scaled)
rain-on-snow surcharge and ponding (optional input, not applied; sensitivity only)
tree fall under ice weight (recorded, not built)
contents, loss of use, business interruption
hazard_scope.compound_event_rule: All perils on one building in one event together at most 100 % of structure value (consumer).

hazard_axis.bridge: Hazard: kPa = 0.00980665 x SWE (mm); house records convert internally to psf (/0.047880259)
hazard_axis.category_guardrail: a return-level map is not an event load; use the event's ground snow load
hazard_axis.extrapolation_policy: load < 0 rejects; 0-20 kPa straight lines between knots; > 20 withholds

selector_logic.effect: fixed identity of the reference building
house only: central or lower-sensitivity fragility
office/warehouse: load factor on snow 1.0 (7-22, strength-level maps) or 1.6 (7-10, 50-year maps)
acknowledges the T4 partial-failure threshold, fitted sag point, archetype readings and leak-or-partial loss (collapse loss is T3)

conditioner_logic.effect: the building's design ground snow load; ASCE 7-22 Risk Category II layer unless the building's category or edition is known
informational: names the layer the design load was read from; the curve does not change
accepted and IGNORED in model v0.1 (flag RAIN_ON_SNOW_SURCHARGE_NOT_APPLIED); sensitivity only

exposure_contract.required_subject_grain: one reference building at one grid cell
exposure_contract.value_rule: loss = DR x structure replacement cost new (once per building)

evaluation_contract.out_of_range_behavior: load above 20 kPa or design load above 300 psf (14.364 kPa): withhold; negative: error

emit_contract.supported_output: conditional scalar DR of the structure; state probabilities in STATE_PROBABILITIES csv (not emitted)
emit_contract.scenario_loss: withheld until the consumer qualifies the building value
emit_contract.withheld_units_emit: explicit null DR plus reason codes; never zero

conditions: reference_building_id must be one of the three Hazard reference profiles r1 buildings
ground_snow_load_kpa is the event ground snow load in kPa at the building, = 0.00980665 x snow water equivalent in mm
records are valid from 0 to 20 kPa; above 20 withholds; a negative load is rejected

office and warehouse need design_ground_snow_load_kpa (the building's design ground snow load; ASCE 7-22 Risk Category II layer by default) and the screening acknowledgement; the record of the band whose lower edge is the largest edge at or below the input is used
office and warehouse: ground_to_roof_case nsls2020_central (default) or kl047_severe; report both
house: house_fragility_variant printed_table4_r1 (default, central) or rebuild_65psf_r1 (lower sensitivity)
the damage ratio is a share of the whole structure's replacement cost new (sources state building value)
contents and interior water beyond the state definitions are withheld, never zero
scenario dollars stay withheld until the consumer qualifies the building value
SJ must confirm the per-cell design snow-load layer before office/warehouse records can run on the grid

prerequisites: Hazard event ground-snow-load and design-load layers

checks_required: record routing by building, edition, conversion case and design band
DR multiplied by the whole structure RCN, once
all perils on one building in one event at most 100 % of structure value
cap_binding.action_if_fail: withhold the affected DR; do not substitute another record or clamp

required_before_canonical_use: SJ confirms the per-cell design snow-load layer (ASCE 7-22 RC II) and the SWE product
ASCE 7-22 Chapter 7 and Strobel & Liel 2013 read, or their absence accepted
reviewer traces the per-curve methodology files

derivation_rationale.source_spine: House: Li & van de Lindt (2012) Table 4 R1 as printed. Office/warehouse: Kozak & Liel (2015) limit-state model (Eq. 1, Tables 1, 2, 4, 5), reproduced against its Tables 6-7, with the 2020 National Snow Load Study ground-to-roof model as the central case.
derivation_rationale.adopted_form: state exceedance probabilities; DR = sum of P(exactly state i) x loss_i
derivation_rationale.parameter_tier_mix: see PARAMETER_TIER_TABLE and the methodology files
derivation_rationale.uncertainty: source bands kept as sensitivity records/rows; compounded uncertainty is NOT propagated

legacy_comparison.prior_cell_state: none (new cell); a house-only draft exists outside the repository (review run E, 12 Nov) and is superseded
